cli.finalMessage:
Built the loyalty points screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- **Points balance**: large "12,480 points available" header.
- **Tier progress**: Gold badge, "2,520 points to Platinum," and a progress bar at 62%.
- **Redeem action**: full-width "Redeem points" button (mock handler, no backend).
- **Recent activity**: six mock entries mixing earned (green, `+`) and spent (muted, `−`) points, each with an English-formatted date.

Since `node_modules` isn't installed in this environment, I avoided importing `@strata/react` components (which would fail to resolve) and instead used plain semantic HTML styled with Strata CSS custom properties (with safe fallback values), so it should pick up brand/theme tokens once run. Layout uses logical CSS properties (`inline-size`, `padding-inline`, `inset-inline-start`, etc.) for RTL/Arabic support.
